remarks: Explore this newly refreshed end-unit condo, nestled in a serene corner of Middlesex Commons. As you enter the foyer, a private staircase leads you to an airy, open-concept living space filled with natural light. The expansive living room features a cathedral ceiling, a cozy fireplace, and a skylight, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere. Step out onto the spacious balcony to enjoy tranquil views of the wooded area, offering a perfect retreat for relaxation. The primary suite boasts a vaulted ceiling and another skylight, along with two generously sized closets, including one oversized closet with a window. The updated en-suite bathroom features a sleek double vanity, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Additional storage is available in the pull-down attic and the detached garage. Located just steps from the vibrant new Corbin District, you'll have easy access to shopping, dining, and fitness studios, plus proximity to the train station for effortless commuting. The condo association offers amenities such as a pool, clubhouse, and guest studio. Embrace the convenience and charm of Darien, all while being just an hour away from the heart of NYC.
